description: This file defines functions and classes related to loading, inspecting, and manipulating mobile TorchScript models in the PyTorch framework, including loading models, retrieving operator info, and backporting models.

classes.name: LiteScriptModule
classes.description: A class representing a lightweight scripted module for mobile, providing methods to invoke and find methods within the module.

methods.name: _load_for_lite_interpreter
methods.description: Loads a LiteScriptModule saved with torch.jit._save_for_lite_interpreter from a file or buffer.

methods.name: find_method
methods.description: Finds a method within the LiteScriptModule by name.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Executes the forward pass of the LiteScriptModule.

methods.name: run_method
methods.description: Runs a specified method within the LiteScriptModule.

methods.name: _export_operator_list
methods.description: Returns a set of root operator names used by the mobile module.

methods.name: _get_model_bytecode_version
methods.description: Retrieves the bytecode version of a model from a file or buffer.

methods.name: _get_mobile_model_contained_types
methods.description: Returns a set of types used in the mobile model bytecode.

methods.name: _backport_for_mobile
methods.description: Backports a model to a specified bytecode version from a file or buffer.

methods.name: _backport_for_mobile_to_buffer
methods.description: Backports a model to a specified bytecode version into a buffer.

methods.name: _get_model_ops_and_info
methods.description: Retrieves root operators and their info from a model file or buffer.
